name: Vejrek
summary: Muren Stormpike asks you to prove your mettle against Vejrek, a troll in the foothills south of Frostmane Hold. Your success earns the start of a lesson in strong defense.

sections.title: A Test of Mettle
sections.body: Muren Stormpike says you need toughness before he can teach you new moves. Vejrek is the toughest troll in these parts, and his hut lies in the foothills south of Frostmane Hold. Muren asks you to bring back Vejrek’s head as proof you can handle real foes.

sections.title: The Lesson
sections.body: Muren accepts Vejrek’s head and says you have what it takes. He is ready to begin teaching you about strong defense, which helps you stay standing against foes that would fell others and supports your allies.

faq.answer: Vejrek is described as the toughest troll in these parts. He has a hut in the foothills south of Frostmane Hold.

faq.q: Why does Muren send me after Vejrek?
faq.answer: Muren wants proof that you can handle real foes before he teaches you new moves.
Vejrek’s hut is in the foothills just south of Frostmane Hold.

faq.q: What does Muren want brought back?
faq.answer: Muren asks you to bring him Vejrek’s head as proof of your mettle.

faq.q: What does Muren teach after the test?
faq.answer: After accepting Vejrek’s head, Muren begins a lesson about strong defense and how it helps you remain standing against foes.
